# Muse23

> Independent software studio. Native Mac and iOS apps, plus consultancy for Apple platforms.

Muse23 is an independent software consultancy specialising in native apps and digital products. It also designs and ships its own indie apps. Founded by Demian Turner.

Product documentation currently ships as HTML. Markdown page mirrors are not published yet.

## Studio

- [About Muse23](https://muse23.com/about/): consultancy, specialties, and indie apps
- [Apps](https://muse23.com/apps/): current and retired products
- [Demian Turner](https://muse23.com/demian-turner/): founder, Apple platforms engineer

## MinkNote

- [MinkNote](https://muse23.com/apps/minknote/): local-first Markdown notes and journals for Mac
- [Docs](https://muse23.com/apps/minknote/docs/): user documentation, generated from a MinkNote journal
- [Features](https://muse23.com/apps/minknote/features.html): product feature overview
- [Pricing](https://muse23.com/apps/minknote/pricing.html): Free and Pro
- [Manifesto](https://muse23.com/apps/minknote/manifesto.html): product principles

## Other apps

- [JustJam](https://muse23.com/apps/justjam/): split songs into stems and play along on Mac, local and offline
- [Which Bin](https://muse23.com/apps/whichbin/): Guildford bin collection reminders for iOS
- [Kids Birthdays](https://muse23.com/apps/kids-birthdays/): iOS app for remembering children's birthdays
- [Crypto Calculator](https://muse23.com/apps/crypto-calculator/): Mac menu bar crypto and fiat converter
- [Pollution Monitor](https://muse23.com/apps/pollution-monitor/): Mac menu bar air quality for thousands of cities
